Maya (CSM): Heads-up — WillowHealth wants to shift their renewal from 12m to 9m and take a seat true‑down for 15 seats. Procurement says they need a new PO + amended SOW before eSign. Can we sync owners?
Evan (WillowHealth): correct — budget cycle changed, CFO approved 9m term instead. We still want same per-seat rate, just shorter term and remove 5 seats now. Need invoice that matches org billing entity.
Tom (Finance): ok on net30 vs net45? Also we need the PO to include vendor_code and the exact billing entity name. Send PO template or short JSON payload we can accept.
Maya (CSM): we can do net30. Po template: ```{
  "po_number": "<PO#>",
  "billing_entity": "WillowHealth, Inc.",
  "vendor_code": "<vendor_code>",
  "amount": "<USD>",
  "term_months": "9"
}``` Fill vendor_code and return to me.
Miguel (RevOps): vendor_code for WillowHealth is usually 8491-EU for EU billing or 8491-US for US. Which entity is this for?
Evan (WillowHealth): US entity. Use 8491-US. PO team said doc needs to reference Amendment v2 and include original contract ID.
Nina (Legal): I can draft a short amendment (term change + seat reduction + proration clause). Timeline: I need counterparty legal to confirm redlines within 48 hours. Who at Willow is their legal contact?
Evan (WillowHealth): Jess Carter (jess.carter@willowhealth.com) — I'll loop her in after you send the draft.
Diego (Onboarding): note: onboarding/training seats will change — we should pause the week-1 enablement for removed seats and adjust training roster. I can rebook sessions for remaining 10 seats. Prefer week of 21st.
Maya (CSM): great — action list: 1) Nina to send amendment draft, 2) Tom to confirm net30 and billing fields, 3) Evan to return PO with vendor_code and attach counterparty legal, 4) I’ll open envelope in DocuSign once PO + signed amendment ready, 5) Diego to tentatively hold week of 21st for enablement.
Tom (Finance): confirmed net30. Will need invoice recipient email and tax ID. Please include tax ID on PO if available.
Evan (WillowHealth): tax ID: 12-3456789. I'll ask PO team to include it. ETA to send PO: tomorrow EOD.
Nina (Legal): draft sent to thread: https://link.internal/ammend-v2-draft (please treat as internal). Key ask: include proration formula for seat removal and effective date. Sample clause: "Charges will be prorated to the nearest day and credited to the customer's next invoice." Thoughts?
Maya (CSM): looks good, Nina. Evan — agree to proration clause?
Evan (WillowHealth): yes, agreeable.
integrations-bot: reminder — changing seat counts triggers entitlement update. Entitlement change request: OPEN: willow-entitlement-8491-US. Diego please confirm dates to avoid training/account lockouts.
Diego (Onboarding): confirming — I'll update entitlement on the 1st of next month after PO clears to avoid mid-session gaps.
Maya (CSM): DocuSign path: once PO PDF + signed amendment are in, I'll create envelope and tag the CSM, finance, and legal. docusign-bot will post envelope id.
docusign-bot: envelope created (placeholder) — EnvelopeID: 0a1b2c3d, status: awaiting signatures. Link: https://docusign.example/0a1b2c3d
Miguel (RevOps): FYI — for billing automation, make sure SOW filename uses pattern: SOW_Willow_2026_Amendment_v2.pdf and include original contract id 7492-RED.
Maya (CSM): recap ✅: Evan to return PO (with vendor_code 8491-US, tax ID, billing entity) by tomorrow EOD; Nina will finalize amendment and send to Jess; Tom OK net30; Diego will schedule onboarding week of 21st and update entitlement 1st of next month; I will kick DocuSign when docs are attached.
Evan (WillowHealth): will do — ping me here if anything blocks. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Maya (CSM): thanks — I'll follow up with a short checklist and update the renewal record in Gainsight.
